senses.gloss:
त्र 1. त्र, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. त्रै), protecting
(in comp.; see अंस-त्˚, अङ्गुलि-त्˚, आतप-त्˚, कटि-
त्˚, &c.).
त्र 2. त्र = त्रि, three, in द्वि-त्र, q. v.

त्रा 1. त्रा (by native authorities written
त्रै, q. v.), cl. 1. A. त्रायते, &c., to pro-
tect, &c. See rt. त्रै, p. 394.

2. त्रा, आस्, m., Ved. a protector, a defender; [cf.
1. त्र.]

त्रंस् त्रंस्, cl. 1. 10. P. त्रंसति, त्रंस-
यति, &c., to speak or shine.

त्रख् त्रख्, cl. 1. P. त्रखति, &c., to
go, move.

त्रङ्क् त्रङ्क्, cl. 1. A. त्रङ्कते, &c., to
go, move.

त्रङ्ख् त्रङ्ख् or त्रङ्ग्, cl. 1. P. त्रङ्खति
or त्रङ्गति, &c., to go or move, (a various
reading for त्वङ्ग्); [cf. Hib. tairgim, ‘I escape;’
tairgeadh, ‘going, passing.’]

त्रङ्ग त्रङ्ग, अस्, आ, m. f. a kind of town
or N. of a town; the city of Hari-ścandra supposed to
be suspended in the air; [cf. द्रङ्क, द्रङ्ग, &c.]

त्रद त्रद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. तृद्), Ved. split-
ting, one who cleaves or opens; a creator; (Sāy.) =
तर्दयितृ, a killer or injurer (of enemies).

त्रन्द् त्रन्द्, cl. 1. P. त्रन्दति, &c., to
act, perform functions; to endeavour,
strive; to be busy.

त्रप् त्रप्, cl. 1. A. त्रपते, त्रेपे, त्र-
पिष्यते and त्रप्स्यते, अत्रपिष्ट and
अत्रप्त, त्रपितुम् and त्रप्तुम्, to become per-
plexed or embarrassed, to be ashamed, be modest:
Caus. त्रपयति and त्रापयति, -यितुम्, to make
perplexed or ashamed: Desid. तित्रपिषते and ति-
त्रप्सते: Intens. तात्रप्यते, तात्रप्ति; [cf. Gr.
τρέπω, έν-τρέπω; Lat. turpis, probably also trepi-
dus, = Ved. तृप्र, ‘hastening;’ Lith. trópiyu, ‘to
throw;’ Slav. trepet, ‘trembling;’ probably Goth.
dreiban; Angl. Sax. drif-an, dref-an.]

त्रप, अस्, आ, m. f. (more commonly आ, f.), per-
plexity, embarrassment, bashfulness, shame, modesty;
(आ), f. an unchaste woman (a shame to her family);
family, race; fame, celebrity; [cf. Gr. ἐν-τροπή.]
—त्रपा-निरस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, shameless, impudent.
—त्रपान्वित (˚पा-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, modest, bash-
ful, ashamed.
—त्रपा-भर, अस्, आ, अम्, overcome
with shame.
—त्रपा-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, bashful,
modest.
—त्रपा-रण्डा, f. a harlot.
—त्रपा-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, modest, ashamed.
—त्रपा-हीन, अस्, आ,
अम्, shameless, immodest, impudent.
त्रपमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being ashamed.
त्रपित, अस्, आ, अम्, modest, bashful, ashamed.

त्रपु, उ, n. tin; lead; (tin is said to be called
त्रपु from its contracting just before melting; cf.
लज्जालु, as a N. of the sensitive plant.)
—त्रपु-
कर्कटी, f. a kind of cucumber, = त्रपुसी.
—त्रपु-
कर्णिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having tin ear-ornaments; (ई),
m. an epithet of Bhava-nandin.
त्रपुल, अम्, n. tin, lead.

त्रपुष, अस्, m., N. of a merchant; a cucumber
or melon; (ई), f. = त्रपुसी; (अम्), n. cucumber,
the fruit of the Trapuṣī; tin.

त्रपुस, अम्, n. cucumber, the fruit of the
Trapusī; tin; (ई), f. coloquintida and other sorts
of cucumber, = महेन्द्र-वारुणी, कर्कटी, पीत-
पुष्पा.

त्रापुष त्रापुष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. त्रपु), made
of tin [cf. जातुष]; silver (produced from tin).

त्रापुस त्रापुस, अस्, ई, अम्, sprung or coming
from the plant Trapusī.
त्रपुस्, उस्, n. tin; [cf. त्रापुष.]
त्रपुस् त्रपुस्. See under rt. त्रप् above.

त्रपाक त्रपाक, अस्, m., N. of a barbarous
tribe.

त्रपिष्ठ त्रपिष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of तृ-
प्र), highly satisfied, much pleased or contented.

त्रपीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of तृप्र), more
satisfied, highly pleased.

त्रपुटी त्रपुटी, f. small cardamoms; [cf.
also त्रि-पुटा and त्रि-पुटी.]

त्रप्र त्रप्र, अम्, n. (a various reading for
वप्र), lead.

त्रप्स्य त्रप्स्य, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt.
तृप्), thin or diluted curds; (according to some
authorities written द्रप्स्य and द्रप्स.)

त्रय त्रय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. त्रि), triple, three-
fold, consisting of three, divided into three parts, of
three kinds, treble; (ई), f., scil. विद्या, the threefold
knowledge, the triple science (i. e. sacred revelation
in its threefold form of hymn, sacrificial formula,
and song, afterwards represented by the Ṛg, Yajur,
and Sāma Vedas), the three Vedas collectively
(omitting the Atharvan, which is not of equal au-
thority); a triad, three collectively, a triplet, three,
(e. g. शत-त्रयी, 300); a matron, a married woman
whose husband and children are living; intellect,
understanding; N. of a plant (Conyza Serratula), =
सोम-राजिन्; (अम्), n. a triad, three collectively,
three, τριάς.
—त्रयी-तनु, उस्, m. an epithet of
the Sun (having the three Vedas for a body, either as
celebrated in the Vedas or because the Sāma-veda
and portions of the other Vedas are said to have
proceeded from the Sun); an epithet of Śiva.
—त्रयी-धर्म, अस्, m. the duty enjoined by the
Vedas (i. e. the forms of sacrifice &c. prescribed by
them).
—त्रयी-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of the
three Vedas, containing them, resting on them, &c.
—त्रयी-मुख, अस्, m. a Brāhman (‘having the
three Vedas in his mouth’).
—त्रयी-विद, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. knowing the triple science; [cf. त्रयी and
त्रैविद.]

त्रयस्, nom. pl. of त्रि, three, (used in comp. with
a following decad, except असीति which takes त्रि. The
other decads, except ten, twenty, and thirty, may also
take त्रि for + 3.)
—त्रयः-पञ्चाशत्, त्, f. fifty-
three; [cf. त्रि-पञ्चाशत्.]
—त्रयः-षष्टि, इस्, f.
sixty-three; [cf. त्रि-षष्टि.]
—त्रयः-सप्तति, इस्,
f. seventy-three; [cf. त्रि-सप्तति.]
—त्रयश्-चत्वा-
रिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the forty-third.
—त्रयश्-चत्वा-
रिंशत्, त्, f. forty-three; [cf. त्रि-चत्वारिंशत्.]
—त्रयस्-त्रिंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the thirty-third; joined
with thirty-three (e. g. त्रयस्त्रिंशं शतम्, 133);
consisting of thirty-three; celebrated with the Stoma
which consists of thirty-three parts or syllables, con-
taining that Stoma, &c.
—त्रयस्-त्रिंशत्, त्, f. thirty-
three.
—त्रयस्-त्रिंशति, इस्, f., Ved. thirty-three.
—त्रयस्त्रिंश-पति, इस्, m. the chief of the thirty-
three gods, an epithet of Indra.
—त्रयस्त्रिंश-
स्तोम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. containing the Trayastriṃśa-
stoma.
—त्रयस्-त्रिंशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, containing thirty-
three.
—त्रयो-दश, अस्, ई, अम्, the thirteenth; joined
with thirteen or having thirteen added (e. g. त्र-
योदशं शतम्, 113); consisting of thirteen; (ई),
f. the thirteenth day of the lunar fortnight; a kind
of gesticulation mentioned in the Purāṇa-sarva-sva.
—त्रयोदशक, consisting of thirteen; (अम्), n. the
number thirteen.
—त्रयोदश-धा, ind. into or in
thirteen parts.
—त्रयो-दशन्, अ, m. f. n. pl. thirteen;
[Gr. τρις-καί-δεκα for τρεῖς-˚ cf. Lat. tredecim for
tres-decem; Lith. trylika fr. trydika.]
—त्रयो-
दशम, अस्, ई, अम्, the thirteenth.
—त्रयोदश-
विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of thirteen kinds.
—त्रयो-
दशिक, happening on the thirteenth day of the
half-moon.
—त्रयो-दशिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. containing
thirteen.
—त्रयो-नवति, इस्, f. ninety-three; [cf.
त्रि-नवति.]
—त्रयोविंश, अस्, ई, अम्, the twenty-
third; consisting of twenty-three.
—त्रयो-विंशति,
इस्, f. twenty-three.
—त्रयो-विंशतिक, अस्, ई,
अम्, consisting of twenty-three.
—त्रयोविंशति-
तम, अस्, ई, अम्, the twenty-third.
—त्रयोविंशति-
धा, ind. in twenty-three parts, in twenty-three
ways, &c.

त्रययाय्य त्रययाय्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (ac-
cording to Sāy.) = त्रातव्य, to be protected.
त्रयोदशन् त्रयो-दशन्. See त्रयस् above.

त्रवाडिलघु त्रवाडि-लघु, उस्, m., N. of the
father of Mahī-dhara.

त्रस् 1. त्रस्, cl. 10. P. त्रासयति, -यितुम्,
to take, seize; to hold; to oppose, pre-
vent, forbid.

त्रस् 2. त्रस्, cl. 1. and 4. P. (ep. also A.)
त्रसति, त्रस्यति, तत्रास (3rd pl. त-
त्रसुस् and त्रेसुस्), त्रसिष्यति, अत्रासीत् and अत्र-
सीत्, त्रसितुम्, to tremble, quiver, quake, or start
with fear; to be agitated, be afraid of; to fear, dread
(with abl. or gen. and more rarely with inst., e. g.
तस्मात् or तस्य त्रस्यति, he fears that or is afraid
of him); to run away, run: Caus. त्रासयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to tremble, terrify, to frighten, scare,
agitate, set in motion: Desid. तित्रसिषति: Intens.
तात्रस्यते, तात्रस्ति; [cf. Zend tareś, tars-ti: Gr.
τρέω for τρεσιyω, ταρταρίζω, τρήπων for τρεσ-
πων, τρέ-μ, τάρβος, ταράσσω, θάλασσα, ὀ-τρηρός,
ὀ-τραλέος: Lat. tristis = trasta; tremo; terreo fr.
terseo for treseo = Caus. त्रासयामि: Goth. thlahs-
yan: Russ. tryasu, ‘to shake;’ tryasu-sy, ‘I
tremble:’ Lett. trīsseht, ‘to tremble:’ Hib. tor,
‘fear, dread.’]

त्रस, अस्, आ, अम्, movable, moving, locomotive;
(अम्), n. the collective body of moving or living
beings; animals; animals and men, (opposed to
स्थावर, cf. जगत्; under त्रस are sometimes
reckoned gods, men, and the inhabitants of the
lower regions); (अस्), m. the heart (‘the quivering
one’); (अम्), n. a forest, a wood.
—त्रस-दस्यु,
उस्, m. ‘before whom evil beings tremble,’ N. of a
prince, (celebrated for his liberality and favoured by the
gods; he bears the patronymic Paurukutsya or Pauru-
kutsi or Paurukutsa, and is supposed to be the author
of certain Ṛg-veda hymns; in the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa
त्रसद्-दस्यु, which is probably the original form,
is identified with Māṃ-dhātṛ and regarded as the
father of Puru-kutsa; the meaning of the name may
be ‘frightening evil beings;’ cf. जमद्-अग्नि, तरद्-
द्वेषस्, भरद्-वाज, &c.)
—त्रस-रेणु, उस्, m. f.
an atom, the mote or atom of dust which is seen
moving in a sun-beam, especially considered as an
ideal weight either of the lowest denomination or
equal to three or (according to some) thirty invisible
atoms; (उस्), f., N. of one of the wives of the Sun.

त्रास, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, movable, locomotive;
frightening; (अस्), m. fear, terror, anxiety; terrifying,
frightening, causing alarm, (often in comp., e. g.
त्रासार्थम्, ind. in order to frighten); a flaw or
defect in a jewel.
—त्रास-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing
fear, fearful, alarming.
—त्रास-दायिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
causing alarm, fear-exciting.

त्रसन, अम्, n. in हस्ति-त्रसनानि, the moving
ornaments of an elephant (?).

त्रासन, अस्, ई, अम्, terrifying, alarming, frighten-
ing (with gen.), making anxious; (अस्), m. epithet of
Śiva; (अम्), n. the act of frightening or alarming; a
means of frightening, cause of alarm, fright.
त्रसर, अस्, m. a shuttle; weaving; = तसर.
त्रसुर, अस्, आ, अम्, trembling, timid, fearful.

त्रस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, frighted, alarmed; timid,
trembling, fearful; quick.
—त्रस्त-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्,
terrified, fearful.
त्रस्नु, उस्, उस्, उ, fearful, timid, timorous.
त्रस्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fearing, apprehending.

त्रासदस्यव, अस्, m. a patronymic from Tra-
sad-dasyu; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
त्रासनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be dreaded, frightened, &c.
त्रासित, अस्, आ, अम्, frightened, scared, alarmed.
त्रासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fearful, timid, afraid.

त्राण, अस्, आ, अम्, preserved, saved, guarded, pro-
tected; (अम्), n. protecting, preserving; protection,
a preservative, defence; shelter, help, (often in
comp., e. g. आर्त-त्राणाय, for the protection of the
[]
distressed; आत्म-त्राण, self-defence); protection for
the body, armour; (आ), f., N. of a plant, = त्राय-
माणा; [cf. Hib. troiath, ‘a helmet.’]
—त्राण-
कर्तृ, ता, or त्राण-कारिन्, ई, m. a preserver, pro-
tector, saviour, deliverer.

त्राण, त्रात, &c. For these and other deriva-
tives of the rt. त्रै see 1. त्रा, p. 388, col. 1.

त्रात, अस्, आ, अम्, preserved, rescued, guarded,
protected; (अस्), m., N. of a man; (अम्), n. pre-
serving, protection.
त्रातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be guarded or protected.

त्रातृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a protector, saviour, guardian,
defender; protecting, defending.
त्रात्र, अम्, n. defence, protection.
त्रात्वा, ind. having preserved or rescued.
त्रामन्, अ, n., Ved. protection; [cf. सु-त्रामन्.]
त्रायन्तिका, f. a medicinal plant.

त्रायमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, preserving, defending, a
preserver; (आ), f., N. of a medicinal plant; also
त्रायमाणिका, f.; [cf. कृत-त्रा.]

त्राहि (2nd sing. impv. of rt. त्रै), save! deliver!
to the rescue!

त्रायोदश त्रायोदश, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. त्रयो-
दशी), relating &c. to the thirteenth day of a half-
moon.
